mapper.sql: select cert_id, cert_code, cert_name, cert_url, issuance_date, cert_period, acquire_way, competition_series_id, competition_stage_id, competition_track_id, second_level_code, course_id, training_program_id, cert_exchange_id, cert_status, team_code, awards_name, org_code, year, cert_config_id, user_id, id_card, user_name, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, version from user_certificate
mapper.select: select cert_id, cert_code, cert_name, cert_url, issuance_date, cert_period, acquire_way, competition_series_id, competition_stage_id, competition_track_id, second_level_code, course_id, training_program_id, cert_exchange_id, cert_status, team_code, awards_name, org_code, year, cert_config_id, user_id, id_card, user_name, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, version from user_certificate where cert_id = #{certId} and user_id = #{userId} and competition_series_id = #{competitionSeriesId} and del_flag = '0' union all select cert_id, cert_code, cert_name, cert_url, issuance_date, cert_period, acquire_way, competition_series_id, competition_stage_id,competition_track_id, second_level_code, course_id, training_program_id, cert_exchange_id, cert_status, team_code, awards_name, org_code, year, cert_config_id, user_id, id_card, user_name, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, version from user_certificate_origin where cert_id = #{certId} and user_id = #{userId} and competition_series_id = #{competitionSeriesId} and del_flag = '0'

SELECT h.cert_id, h.cert_code, h.cert_name, h.cert_url, h.issuance_date, h.cert_period, h.acquire_way, h.competition_series_id, h.competition_track_id, h.second_level_code, h.course_id, h.training_program_id, h.cert_exchange_id, h.cert_status, h.team_code, h.awards_name, h.org_code, h.create_by, h.create_time, h.update_by, h.update_time, h.del_flag, h.version, h.year, h.competition_stage_id, NULL AS competition_stage_name, h.school AS school_id, h.school_name, h.user_id, h.cert_config_id, NULL AS id_card, h.user_name, h.player, h.guide_teacher, csi.competition_series_name, csi.competition_name, h.competition_track_name, h.second_level_name, NULL AS org_name FROM user_certificate_history h LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.competition_series_id, a.competition_series_name, b.competition_name FROM competition_series_info a LEFT JOIN competition_main_info b ON a.competition_id = b.competition_id ) csi ON h.competition_series_id = csi.competition_series_id WHERE h.del_flag = '0'
AND h.school_name LIKE concat('%', #{schoolName}, '%') AND h.player LIKE concat('%', #{userName}, '%') AND NOT (h.user_name = h.school_name AND h.player = h.school_name)
AND h.school_name LIKE concat('%', #{schoolName}, '%') AND h.user_name = h.school_name AND h.player = h.school_name
AND h.cert_code = #{certCode}
ORDER BY h.create_time IS NULL, h.create_time DESC LIMIT 100
where cert_config_id = #{certConfigId} and id_card = #{idCard} and del_flag = '0'
